patch_resolves_note: The official fixed patch applied cleanly in the reused workspace. Both target-only rebuild attempts fell back to `/bin/arvo compile`, but the fixed instrumented target still ran clean and emitted the protected in-bounds terminator write on the original PoC.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project parser statement on the vulnerable path. `gf_isom_box_parse_ex()` materializes the attacker-controlled root-box size and starts the header-size bookkeeping later used to derive the payload length passed to `diST_box_read()`.

Root cause. The `diST` string reader is controlled only by a sentinel-NUL loop and never bounds `i` against the fixed `str[1024]` extent or checks the remaining payload length `s->size` before each byte read.
ASan sink. After 1024 non-NUL bytes have advanced `i` to 1024, this assignment writes one byte to `str[1024]`, one byte past the 1024-byte stack buffer.

edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `dist_write_guard.write_index == dist_write_sink.write_index == 1024`; the fixed original records the same guard-to-sink equality with value `24`.
